title: A Drops-lines trailer on docs/debts/notes.md excuses only the note it names
why: A `Drops-lines` trailer on docs/debts/notes.md excuses every revived note, not only the one it names (debt note notes-trailer-whole-file in #1943; lane lint-uses-pinned-tools, 06:44 CST Nov 8).
note: Fix: the silent-undo check matches a notes.md trailer to the slug it names; red case first. Doing in lane lint-uses-pinned-tools (session_013NEJL1N3YkCMouc1pELXyu) on branch notes-trailer-per-slug, Merge after: #1943. #1943 cites `Fix: step:notes-trailer-per-slug`. Folded in proposed step note-rewrite-keeps-claims (timing-tests lane, session_013NEJL1jPC89ae6X6Pa4jmf, 08:19 CST Nov 8): twice today a rewrite or fold of a notes.md line dropped one sentence that was still true (#1958 d4163eceb, #2002 6c8b057cb), and each time a haiku fix check caught it and forced a new review chain. Check idea: when a commit removes a note line and adds one under the same or a folding id, list each removed sentence with no close match in the added lines and require a Drops-lines reason that names it. Same home: the silent-undo Drops-lines check on notes.md.
